description: Header file defining the Monitor plugin class for WPEFramework, including nested classes for configuration, metadata, and monitoring objects, with methods for initialization, web processing, and monitoring control.

classes.name: Monitor
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing monitoring functionality, configuration, and web interface.

classes.name: Data
classes.description: Class representing JSON data structure for monitor information.

classes.name: RestartInfo
classes.description: JSON container for restart window and limit configuration.

classes.name: MonitorObjects
classes.description: Container managing multiple MonitorObject instances, handling their lifecycle and evaluation.

classes.name: MonitorObject
classes.description: Represents individual monitored entity with memory and operational status, restart management, and evaluation logic.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the service, sets up monitoring based on configuration.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleans up resources.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.

methods.name: endpoint_restartlimits
methods.description: Handles restart limits configuration via web.

methods.name: get_status
methods.description: Retrieves current status of monitored entities.

methods.name: event_action
methods.description: Triggers events/actions based on monitoring results.
